scenarios.title: Widen a documentation bot and drop a guardrail
scenarios.description: A pull request to a group of gh-aw workflows: docs-bot reaches another repository, gains a toolset, a lower min-integrity, a cross-repository pull request output and more AI credits, and stops loading its check-links guardrail; docs-bot-links opens bash and its network; docs-bot-examples narrows; docs-bot-digest joins the group; issue-triage changes without being recompiled, so its lock file is stale. Interpreted by the agentic-workflows comparator.

scenarios.title: The same change as a matrix
scenarios.description: The docs-bot pull request with the view control set to the matrix: each workflow against what it loads, the tools it uses, what it writes and the network it reaches.

scenarios.title: Widen a public workflow's network
scenarios.description: githubnext/agentics' repo-ask, and a pull request that lets it reach Python's package index and Read the Docs, adds the actions toolset, an issue output and a higher comment limit, and raises its timeout. Interpreted by the agentic-workflows comparator.

scenarios.title: The same change, default comparator
scenarios.description: The repo-ask pull request compared by the default comparator: every entry that arrives or leaves is marked, without the comparator's directions.

scenarios.title: Public workflows at a glance
scenarios.description: One revision of real workflows from gh-aw and githubnext/agentics: a network allowlist widened through a shared import, skills, safe outputs with their default limits, and lock files compiled by gh-aw v1.3.0 and v0.93.3, all current.
